provenance.client: KakaoTalk server via the owned Mac-class secondary profile; native request rules from static KakaoTalk for Mac 26.8.0 arm64
provenance.method: Owned A/B/C regular-group differential (markread-8b): A's official Android client sent synthetic texts, the Matrix tester's read receipt drove the bridge's MarkRead, and A's per-message unread counts were read before and after each request. Server responses are the observed status, isOK and returned log positions; log IDs are replaced with small synthetic values that keep their order. Requests are the ones the bridge sent and the server answered as listed.

server_rule: isOK=true, and the chat is marked read through max, exactly when cnt is at least the number of logs in (cur, max]; otherwise the response returns the logs, isOK=false, and nothing is marked read.

cases.name: never acknowledged chat with an unbridged older feed
every log after the confirmed position is held
undercount ends with the empty range at the watermark
overcount is confirmed
cases.note: The server held two logs in the range; a held row it does not count (synthetic 20) still yields isOK and a read.
